## **“Cousins” with NBA Legends Vince Carter and Tracy McGrady Returns for Season 2**


10.20.2026


**AMP Sports' Video Podcast Returns Wednesday, October 21 with Guests** **Carmelo Anthony, Reggie Miller, and Jamal Crawford**


**BALTIMORE – October 20, 2026** – Sinclair's AMP Sports today announced the return of


*Cousins* , the video podcast hosted by NBA All-Stars, Hall of Famers, entrepreneurs, and real-life cousins Vince Carter and Tracy “T-Mac” McGrady, for a second season premiering this Wednesday, October 21


st


.


Season 2’s first episode


features interviews with Carmelo Anthony, Reggie Miller, and Jamal Crawford.


Building on its debut season,


*Cousins* returns with more of the candid conversations, basketball insights and personal stories that bring fans closer to two of the most electrifying players in NBA history. From breaking down today's biggest NBA storylines to revisiting the unforgettable moments and personalities that defined their careers, Carter and McGrady bring a perspective shaped by decades in the game and a family connection that makes every conversation unique.


*Cousins* has built a following of more than 550,000 across platforms and generated a cumulative reach of 375 million. The show's first season featured conversations with high-profile guests including Luka Dončić, Donovan Mitchell and Lamar Odom, giving fans an inside look at basketball through the experiences, relationships and untold stories of some of the game's biggest names. Season 2 builds on that momentum with more of the humor, debate and behind-the-scenes stories that define the series.


“Vince and Tracy are two of the most influential players of their era, and their personalities, storytelling, and chemistry have helped them connect with fans and players across generations,” said Rich Cooke, Vice President, Audio Programming. “We’re excited to bring


*Cousins* back for another season as part of AMP Sports’ growing podcast portfolio, creating new ways for fans of every level of the game to engage with Vince and Tracy on all platforms.”


Sponsors Xfinity, ZipRecruiter and Uncrustables return for Season 2, continuing their partnerships with Cousins and its growing audience of passionate basketball fans.


*Cousins* is available on


[YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@VinceAndTmac) , Spotify, Apple Podcasts and all major podcast platforms, with new episodes dropping every Wednesday. Fans can follow @vinceandtmac across social media for show highlights, behind-the-scenes content and exclusive extras.


“The best part about doing this show together is that we can just be ourselves, said Carter and McGrady. “We’ve known some of these guys for decades. We’ve played with them, played against them, and have stories that go beyond what happened on the court. When we get together, you never really know where the conversation is going to go, and that’s what makes it fun. Season 2 is going to be a good one.”


Cousins is


part of AMP Sports growing slate of original video podcasts which include


*The Triple Option* with Urban Meyer, Mark Ingram II and Rob Stone,


*Unfiltered Soccer* with Landon Donovan and Tim Howard,


*Throwbacks* with Matt Leinart and Jerry Ferrara,


*Post Moves* with Candace Parker and Aliyah Boston, and


*Style of Play* with Julie Ertz and Kealia Watt.


**About The Hosts:**


**Vince Carter** is a retired professional basketball player and eight-time NBA All-Star, who played 22 seasons in the NBA, tied for the most in league history. Carter earned the nickname “Vinsanity” and became one of the most electrifying players of his era. A two-time All-NBA selection and the 1999 NBA Rookie of the Year, he also represented the United States at the 2000 Sydney Olympics, where he won a gold medal and delivered one of the most iconic dunks in international basketball history. In 2024, Carter was inducted into the Naismith Memorial Basketball Hall of Fame. Carter is currently an analyst for NBC Sports and YES Network. He has previously worked for both ESPN and TNT Sports.


**Tracy McGrady** is a seven-time NBA All-Star, two-time NBA scoring champion, Hall of Famer, and entrepreneur who currently serves as an NBA analyst for NBC Sports and co-hosts the


*Cousins* podcast. A native of Auburndale, Florida, McGrady made the leap directly from high school to the NBA, establishing himself as one of the most dynamic and prolific scorers of his generation throughout his 15-year NBA career. Since retiring from professional basketball, McGrady has expanded his influence and investment portfolio across sports and media, with a particular focus on acquiring and investing in businesses that create opportunities for the next generation of athletes. He founded the Ones Basketball League (OBL), a competitive one-on-one basketball league designed to spotlight emerging talent, and acquired and revived the legendary ABCD Camp, reimagining the iconic development platform for a new generation and launching its first-ever girls' camp. In 2024, McGrady also joined the ownership group of the Buffalo Bills, furthering his commitment to shaping the future of sports through ownership, investment, and athlete development.


**About AMP Sports**


AMP Sports, a division of Sinclair’s AMP Media, connects brands to passionate sports fans with national scale, regional impact and local relevance. AMP Sports distributes highly engaging programming across linear and digital platforms, powered by a growing slate of original video podcasts, including


*The Triple Option* with Urban Meyer, Mark Ingram II and Rob Stone,


*Unfiltered Soccer* with Landon Donovan and Tim Howard,


*Throwbacks* with Matt Leinart and Jerry Ferrara,


*Post Moves* with Candace Parker and Aliyah Boston,


*Cousins* with Vince Carter and Tracy McGrady and


*Style of Play* with Julie Ertz and Kealia Watt. AMP Sports also produces and distributes a robust network of college and professional football shows. AMP Media, in partnership with SMAC Productions, also operates The Intersection, an original podcast network featuring


*Get TO The Point* , with Terrell Owens and Chris Spencer and


*Hustle Like You’re Broke w* ith Michael Strahan and Constance Schwartz-Morini.
